item.name: Create or find an auth agent

request.name: Create or find an auth agent

description.content: **Deprecated: Use POST /auth/connections instead.** Creates a new auth agent for the specified domain and profile combination, or returns an existing one if it already exists. This is idempotent - calling with the same domain and profile will return the same agent. Does NOT start an invocation - use POST /agents/auth/invocations to start an auth flow.
